correctness.rationale: For persistent birelational iK semantics, x<=y entails R(y) subset R(x). All upsets U make Box U stable along comparisons precisely when R(x) subset upward-closure R(y). Necessity uses U=up R(y) to falsify atomic Box p or not Box p at x if x<=y and a successor of x lies outside up R(y); sufficiency gives reverse Box persistence. On n-chain, nested rows sharing a common upward closure are empty or share least successor m; independent cutoffs for each target j>m give (n+1)^(n-1-m), hence C_n=1+sum_{j=0}^{n-1}(n+1)^j. Strong-condition rows are constant: 2^n. The two-point rows {0,1},{0} are a sharp counterexample. Independent literal enumeration over all nested row systems and upward-closed atomic valuations yielded n=1..4 counts 2,5,22,157, independently matching formula; these finite tests do not establish infinite correspondence.
